request.prompt:
A 3x2 grid of six separate square video-game icon paintings, three across and two down. Each painting fills its square cell edge to edge, thin black gutters between the cells, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames. Each cell has its OWN distinct colour palette and time of day; the six must look clearly different in colour from each other - avoid any overall amber, golden, brown or sepia cast.
Top row, left: HERBAL MEDICINE - a Korean Buddhist monk's hands grinding green medicinal herbs in a grey stone mortar beside white porcelain bowls and fresh green leaves; cool morning daylight; palette of celadon jade green, white and soft grey.
Top row, middle: COMMUNITY LABOUR - Joseon Korean farmers in white hanbok planting bright green rice seedlings together in a flooded paddy, a tall farmers' banner with red and blue streamers above them; clear blue sky; palette of sky blue, fresh spring green and white.
Top row, right: SHORT ARROWS - a Korean horn bow with short darts (pyeonjeon) and the half-pipe wooden arrow guide (tongah) laid out, crimson bow grip; deep indigo night sky with a pale moon; palette of indigo, steel blue and crimson.
Bottom row, left: WARRIOR MONKS - three Korean warrior monks in grey robes with red sashes holding long staves before a mountain temple gate in falling snow; palette of cool grey, white and crimson.
Bottom row, middle: MOUNTED MONK - a Korean Buddhist monk in a grey robe and red kasaya riding a dark horse, a bow on his back, misty pine mountains behind; palette of grey-green, mist white and red.
Bottom row, right: HARVEST TOGETHER - Korean villagers carrying rice sheaves on wooden A-frame back carriers (jige) along a paddy dyke at dusk; palette of violet sky, rose and teal.
Style: painted strategy-game icons in the manner of Age of Empires III Definitive Edition tech icons, strong readable silhouette, one clear subject centred in each cell, reads at 64 pixels. This is a stylised video-game illustration, NOT a photograph and NOT photorealistic: visible painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated features and saturated game-art colours, simplified textures, no camera lens effects, no skin pores, no photographic depth of field.
